caption: The drawing depicts a single figure standing in the center, clothed in a long garment that is beige with black outlining, featuring a prominent vertical red section down the middle. The figure has a halo around the head, which is outlined in brown and yellow hues, and the hair and beard are black. The person holds a staff or scepter in the left hand, with the right hand raised and fingers extended. To the left of the figure is a rectangular black area bordered in red, with several horizontal black lines below it and a coiled, snake-like shape beneath. To the right of the figure are two tall architectural structures colored in red, black, and beige, one topped with a cross and another with a bird or animal perched on it. The background of the drawing is filled with a light brown color with visible texture lines, and the entire scene is enclosed within a thick, irregular black border. The composition places the central figure as the focal point, surrounded by architectural and symbolic elements, all rendered in muted earth tones with highlights of red and black.
title: Retablos
